say:5:1321702003:1.text: Rest assured, there's no immediate danger to the duchy.
say:5:1321702003:1.source_cn: 没有，公国内暂时没有异常，您不必担心。

say:6:1321702004:0.text: This concerns the arrangements for the <style="highlight">funeral of the Archduke and Princess Yolena</style>. Captain Rodrigo seeks your assistance.
say:6:1321702004:0.source_cn: 是城堡里正在<style=highlight>筹备大公...

say:7:1321702005:1.text: So it's really time for Princess Yolena's funeral...
say:7:1321702005:1.source_cn: 要准备公主殿下的葬礼了……？

say:8:1321702006:1.text: It doesn't feel real... We saw the real her once, didn't we? In that illusion the Frost Furie created.
say:8:1321702006:1.source_cn: 感觉好不真实……亚莲娜公主，我们曾经在冰之恶魔营造的幻...

say:9:1321702007:1.text: Are we truly saying goodbye to the real her now?
say:9:1321702007:1.source_cn: 要和她——真正的她——道别了吗？

say:10:1321702008:1.text: Yes... the entire duchy grieves her loss, but these preparations can no longer be delayed.
say:10:1321702008:1.source_cn: 是的……唉，举国上下都很伤心，但是这件事实在不宜搁置太久。

say:11:1321702009:1.text: Your presence would mean so much to us. If you're able, please make your way to the castle as soon as possible. The people of the duchy will never forget your kindness.
say:11:1321702009:1.source_cn: 要是时间允许的话，请各位尽快移步城堡吧……公国子民，将...
